program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to multi-step context transition attribution
question: Which frozen training-only context partition most strongly explains the depth-2/depth-3 transition errors once beam truncation is removed as the limiting factor?
hypothesis: Using the sealed 512-motif representation and identical heldout queries, stratify transition predictions by training-only exact-pair support and ambiguity margin. If transition quality is the bottleneck, low-support and/or high-ambiguity strata will account for a disproportionate share of depth-3 top-1 errors without changing learned capacity.

prior_evidence.observation: runtime cap 512->2048 raised minimum retained mass 0.710419->1.0 while depth-2/depth-3 pooled top-1 accuracy was unchanged

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_relation: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair successor counts plus overflow

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and a frozen training-only support/ambiguity stratum accounts for a disproportionate share of depth-3 errors relative to its query share, identifying a bounded transition-quality target.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes but attribution is distributed across multiple frozen strata.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but neither frozen support nor ambiguity strata explain transition error concentration.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, stratum, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
All stratum definitions are computed from training-prefix statistics only and frozen before heldout scoring.
The learned 512-motif substrate and all relation tables are unchanged.
Runtime cap remains 2048 for all comparisons; no capacity experiment is performed.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, relations, support threshold, ambiguity cutoff, strata, horizons, runtime cap, controls, metrics, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: apply one bounded training-only context transition repair to the attributed stratum without capacity growth

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: test bounded context-conditioned state attribution before changing capacity
